answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond on a basalt-hard ledger and earn trust only through a long, verifiable history of useful work, like a lantern kept lit night after night on a remote island. New identities start with no voting weight, and established peers must stake part of their own bond to vouch for them. Creating a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand bonds plus months of real work, and a fraud vouch slashes the voucher too, so Sybil farming becomes expensive and unprofitable.
